questions.text: एक पहिए का व्यास 63 cm है। इस पहिए के द्वारा 100 चक्करों में तय की गई दूरी है:
questions.text_english: The diameter of a wheel is 63 cm. The distance travelled by the wheel in 100 revolutions is:
questions.solution: The circumference of the wheel = π × diameter = (22/7) × 63 = 198 cm. Distance in 100 revolutions = 198 × 100 = 19800 cm = 198 m. Option B is correct. Option A (99 m) would be distance in 50 revolutions. Options C and D are not derived from the correct formula.

questions.text: सात प्रेक्षणों का माध्य 17 है। यदि पहले चार प्रेक्षणों का माध्य 15 तथा आखिरी चार प्रेक्षणों का माध्य 18 है, तो चौथा प्रेक्षण है:
questions.text_english: The mean of seven observations is 17. If the mean of the first four observations is 15 and that of the last four observations is 18, then the fourth observation is:
questions.solution: Total sum of 7 observations = 7 × 17 = 119. Sum of first 4 observations = 4 × 15 = 60. Sum of last 4 observations = 4 × 18 = 72. The 4th observation is counted in both groups, so: 4th observation = 60 + 72 − 119 = 132 − 119 = 13. Wait, recalculating: 60 + 72 = 132, and 132 − 119 = 13. So the correct answer is 13, which is option B. Option A (14) is incorrect as 60 + 72 − 119 = 13, not 14.

questions.text: बिंदु (4, 0) की x-अक्ष से दूरी है:
questions.text_english: The distance of the point (4, 0) from x-axis is:
questions.solution: The distance of any point (x, y) from the x-axis is the absolute value of its y-coordinate, i.e., |y|. For the point (4, 0), the y-coordinate is 0, so the distance from the x-axis is |0| = 0 units. Option C is correct. The distance from the y-axis would be 4 units (option A), which is a common confusion.

questions.text: यदि α तथा β बहुपद p(x) = kx² − 30x + 45k के शून्यक हैं तथा α + β = αβ है, तो 'k' का मान है:
questions.text_english: If α and β are zeroes of the polynomial p(x) = kx² − 30x + 45k and α + β = αβ, then the value of 'k' is:
questions.solution: For p(x) = kx² − 30x + 45k, by Vieta's formulas: α + β = 30/k and αβ = 45k/k = 45. Since α + β = αβ, we get 30/k = 45, which gives k = 30/45 = 2/3. Option D is correct. The other options do not satisfy the condition α + β = αβ when substituted back.

questions.text: एक गोले की त्रिज्या 'r', एक शंकु के आधार की त्रिज्या के समान है। यदि उनके आयतन भी समान हैं, तो शंकु की ऊँचाई है:
questions.text_english: The radii 'r' of a sphere and that of the base of a cone are same. If their volumes are also same, then the height of the cone is:
questions.solution: Volume of sphere = (4/3)πr³. Volume of cone = (1/3)πr²h. Setting them equal: (4/3)πr³ = (1/3)πr²h, which gives 4r³ = r²h, so h = 4r. Option D is correct. Options A, B, and C yield volumes smaller than the sphere's volume.

questions.text: यदि किसी लाटरी में, 10 स्थानों पर इनाम हैं तथा 30 स्थान खाली हैं, तो एक इनाम जीतने की प्रायिकता है:
questions.text_english: If in a lottery, there are 10 prizes and 30 blanks, then the probability of winning a prize is:
questions.solution: Total tickets = 10 (prizes) + 30 (blanks) = 40. Probability of winning a prize = Number of prize tickets / Total tickets = 10/40 = 1/4. Option A is correct. Option B (1/3) would be the ratio of prizes to blanks, not to total tickets, which is a common error.

questions.text: यदि tan 3θ = √3 है, तो θ/2 बराबर है:
questions.text_english: If tan 3θ = √3, then θ/2 equals:
questions.solution: tan 3θ = √3 = tan 60°, so 3θ = 60°, giving θ = 20°. Therefore θ/2 = 20°/2 = 10°. Option D is correct. Option C (20°) is the value of θ itself, not θ/2, which is the most common mistake here.

questions.text: यदि दो त्रिभुजों △DEF तथा △PQR में, ∠D = ∠Q तथा ∠R = ∠E है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सही नहीं है?
questions.text_english: If in two triangles △DEF and △PQR, ∠D = ∠Q and ∠R = ∠E, then which of the following is not true?
questions.solution: Since ∠D = ∠Q and ∠R = ∠E, the third angles are also equal: ∠F = ∠P. The correspondence is D↔Q, E↔R, F↔P, so △DEF ~ △QRP. This gives DE/QR = EF/RP = DF/QP. Option A states DE/QR = DF/PQ, but it should be DE/QR = DF/QP, making option A incorrect. Options B, C, and D are consistent with the correct similarity correspondence.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, △ABC में, AD ⊥ BC तथा ∠BAC = 90° है। यदि BC = 16 cm तथा DC = 4 cm है, तो x का मान है:
questions.text_english: In the given figure, in △ABC, AD ⊥ BC and ∠BAC = 90°. If BC = 16 cm and DC = 4 cm, then the value of x is:
questions.image_description: A right triangle ABC with ∠BAC = 90°. AD is perpendicular to BC. D lies on BC with DC = 4 cm, BC = 16 cm. The side AC = x is marked. The altitude AD creates two smaller triangles.
questions.solution: Since ∠BAC = 90° and AD ⊥ BC, by the geometric mean relation: AC² = DC × BC. So x² = 4 × 16 = 64, giving x = 8 cm. Wait, that gives option C. Let me reconsider: AD² = BD × DC = 12 × 4 = 48. And AC² = DC × BC = 4 × 16 = 64, so AC = 8 cm. But x in the figure labels AC = x. Checking option C: x = 8 cm is correct by the relation AC² = DC × BC = 4 × 16 = 64, x = 8 cm. Option C (8 cm) is correct.

questions.text: △PQR के दो शीर्ष P(−1, 5) तथा Q(5, 2) हैं। रेखाखण्ड PQ को 2 : 1 के अनुपात में बाँटने वाले बिंदु के निर्देशांक हैं:
questions.text_english: Two of the vertices of △PQR are P(−1, 5) and Q(5, 2). The coordinates of a point which divides PQ in the ratio 2 : 1 are:
questions.solution: Using the section formula for ratio m:n = 2:1, the point dividing P(−1, 5) and Q(5, 2) is: x = (2×5 + 1×(−1))/(2+1) = (10−1)/3 = 9/3 = 3; y = (2×2 + 1×5)/(2+1) = (4+5)/3 = 9/3 = 3. So the point is (3, 3). Option C is correct. Option A has an incorrect y-value arising from sign errors.

questions.text: (cot θ + tan θ) बराबर है:
questions.text_english: (cot θ + tan θ) equals:
questions.solution: cot θ + tan θ = cos θ/sin θ + sin θ/cos θ = (cos²θ + sin²θ)/(sin θ cos θ) = 1/(sin θ cos θ) = (1/sin θ)(1/cos θ) = cosec θ · sec θ. Option A is correct. The other options do not simplify to the same expression when basic trigonometric identities are applied.

questions.text: बहुपद p(x) = x² − 3√2 x + 4 के शून्यक हैं:
questions.text_english: Zeroes of the polynomial p(x) = x² − 3√2 x + 4 are:
questions.solution: For p(x) = x² − 3√2 x + 4, we check option B: sum of zeroes = 2√2 + √2 = 3√2 = 3√2/1 (matches −(−3√2)/1), and product = 2√2 × √2 = 2 × 2 = 4 (matches 4/1). Both conditions are satisfied, so the zeroes are 2√2 and √2. Option B is correct. Option A gives sum 2 + √2 ≠ 3√2 and product 2√2 ≠ 4.

questions.text: 'k' का वह मान जिसके लिए रैखिक समीकरण निकाय 6x + y = 3k तथा 36x + 6y = 3 के अपरिमित रूप से अनेक हल हैं, है:
questions.text_english: The value of 'k' for which the system of linear equations 6x + y = 3k and 36x + 6y = 3 have infinitely many solutions is:
questions.solution: For infinitely many solutions, the ratios of coefficients must be equal: a1/a2 = b1/b2 = c1/c2. Here: 6/36 = 1/6 = 1/(6). Also c1/c2 = 3k/3 = k. For consistency: k = 1/6. Option B is correct. If k = 6 (option A), the ratios 6/36 = 1/6 but c1/c2 = 6 ≠ 1/6, giving no solution.
questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables

questions.text: नीचे दी गई आकृति में दो त्रिभुजों LMN तथा ABC के माप दिए गए हैं। भुजा AC की लंबाई है:
questions.text_english: The measurements of △LMN and △ABC are shown in the figure given below. The length of side AC is:
questions.image_description: Two triangles LMN and ABC are shown. In △LMN: LM = 45 cm, MN = 63 cm, LN = 72 cm, angle at M = 130°, angle at N = 28°. In △ABC: AB corresponds to LM, BC = 63 cm shown, AC = 5 cm side shown with angle 22° at A and 130° at B. The triangles are similar by AA criterion.
questions.solution: From the figure, △LMN ~ △ABC (by AA similarity, as the marked angles are equal). The correspondence is L↔A, M↔B, N↔C. The ratio of similarity = BC/MN = 63/63... checking: LM = 45, MN = 63, LN = 72; AB side ~ 5 cm given. Scale factor = 5/45 = 1/9. So AC = LN × (1/9) = 72/9 = 8 cm. Option C is correct.

questions.text: x/4 + y/6 = 1 द्वारा निरूपित रेखा, x-अक्ष तथा y-अक्ष को क्रमश: P तथा Q पर काटती है। रेखाखण्ड PQ के मध्य-बिंदु के निर्देशांक हैं:
questions.text_english: The line represented by x/4 + y/6 = 1, intersects x-axis and y-axis respectively at P and Q. The coordinates of the mid-point of line segment PQ are:
questions.solution: The line x/4 + y/6 = 1 intersects the x-axis when y = 0: x/4 = 1, so x = 4. Thus P = (4, 0). It intersects the y-axis when x = 0: y/6 = 1, so y = 6. Thus Q = (0, 6). Midpoint of PQ = ((4+0)/2, (0+6)/2) = (2, 3). Option A is correct. Option B reverses the coordinates.

questions.text: यदि 4, 6, 8 का ल.स. (LCM) x है, 3, 5, 7 का ल.स. y है तथा x और y का ल.स. p है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सही है?
questions.text_english: If x is the LCM of 4, 6, 8 and y is the LCM of 3, 5, 7 and p is the LCM of x and y, then which of the following is true?
questions.solution: LCM of 4, 6, 8: 4 = 2², 6 = 2×3, 8 = 2³. LCM = 2³ × 3 = 24, so x = 24. LCM of 3, 5, 7 = 3 × 5 × 7 = 105, so y = 105. p = LCM(24, 105). 24 = 2³×3, 105 = 3×5×7. LCM = 2³×3×5×7 = 840. Now check: 4y = 4 × 105 = 420 ≠ 840. Let me recheck: p/y = 840/105 = 8, so p = 8y. Hmm, checking option B: p = 4y = 420 ≠ 840. Option D: p = 16y = 1680 ≠ 840. Option C: p = 8x = 192 ≠ 840. Option A: p = 35x = 840. So p = 35x. Option A is correct.

questions.text_english: If x/12 − 3/x = 0, then the values of x are:
questions.solution: x/12 − 3/x = 0. Multiplying both sides by 12x: x² − 36 = 0, so x² = 36, giving x = ±6. Option A is correct. Option B (±4) gives 4² = 16 ≠ 36, and Option C (±12) gives 144 ≠ 36, confirming these are incorrect.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में केंद्र O वाले वृत्त पर एक बाह्य बिंदु P से यदि PA तथा PB स्पर्श-रेखाएँ खींची गई हैं जिनके बीच का कोण 80° है, तो ∠POA की माप है:
questions.text_english: If tangents PA and PB drawn from an external point P to the circle with centre O are inclined to each other at an angle of 80° as shown in the given figure, then the measure of ∠POA is:
questions.image_description: A circle with centre O. External point P with two tangents PA and PB drawn to the circle. The angle APB = 80°. Points A and B are the points of tangency. OP is a line from the external point to the centre.
questions.solution: In quadrilateral OAPB: ∠OAP = ∠OBP = 90° (radius ⊥ tangent). ∠APB = 80°. Sum of angles = 360°: ∠AOB = 360° − 90° − 90° − 80° = 100°. Since OP bisects ∠AOB (by symmetry), ∠AOP = 50°. Therefore ∠POA = 50°. Option B is correct.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A): एक बाह्य बिंदु से वृत्त पर खींची गई दो स्पर्श-रेखाएँ, वृत्त के केंद्र पर समान कोण अन्तरित करती हैं।
तर्क (R): एक वृत्त के परिगत समांतर चतुर्भुज, एक समचतुर्भुज होता है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): If two tangents are drawn to a circle from an external point, then they subtend equal angles at the centre of the circle.
Reason (R): A parallelogram circumscribing a circle is a rhombus.
questions.instruction_line: निम्नलिखित में से सही उत्तर चुनिए:
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) as given below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion A is true: by symmetry, tangents drawn from an external point to a circle are equal in length, and using congruent triangles (OAP ≅ OBP), the angles subtended at the centre are equal. Reason R is also true: in a parallelogram circumscribing a circle, opposite sides sum to the same value (tangent property), and since opposite sides of a parallelogram are equal, all four sides must be equal, making it a rhombus. However, R does not explain A — R is about a parallelogram's property, not about angles subtended by tangents. Hence option B is correct.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A): दीवार के साथ लगी हुई एक सीढ़ी के पाद की दीवार से क्षैतिज दूरी 6 m है। यदि यह दीवार पर 8 m ऊँचाई तक पहुँचती है, तो सीढ़ी की लंबाई 10 m है।
तर्क (R): सीढ़ी, भूमि से 60° का कोण बनाती है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): A ladder leaning against a wall, stands at a horizontal distance of 6 m from the wall. If the height of the wall up to which the ladder reaches is 8 m, then the length of the ladder is 10 m.
Reason (R): The ladder makes an angle of 60° with the ground.
questions.instruction_line: निम्नलिखित में से सही उत्तर चुनिए:
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) as given below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion A is true: by Pythagoras theorem, length of ladder = √(6² + 8²) = √(36 + 64) = √100 = 10 m. Reason R is false: the angle made by the ladder with the ground is θ = tan⁻¹(8/6) = tan⁻¹(4/3) ≈ 53.13°, not 60°. For a 60° angle, sin 60° = 8/10 = 0.8, but sin 60° = √3/2 ≈ 0.866 ≠ 0.8. Hence Assertion A is true but Reason R is false. Option C is correct.

questions.text: यदि tan A + cot A = 6 है, तो tan² A + cot² A − 4 का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: If tan A + cot A = 6, then find the value of tan² A + cot² A − 4.

key_points: Square both sides: (tan A + cot A)² = 36
tan² A + 2 tan A cot A + cot² A = 36
Since tan A × cot A = 1, we get tan² A + cot² A = 36 − 2 = 34

questions.solution: Given tan A + cot A = 6. Squaring both sides: (tan A + cot A)² = 36, so tan² A + 2(tan A · cot A) + cot² A = 36. Since tan A · cot A = 1, we get tan² A + cot² A + 2 = 36, giving tan² A + cot² A = 34. Therefore, tan² A + cot² A − 4 = 34 − 4 = 30.

sub_questions.text: यदि द्विघात समीकरण 4x² + kx + 1 = 0 के मूल वास्तविक और समान हैं, तो 'k' का/के मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the value(s) of 'k' so that the quadratic equation 4x² + kx + 1 = 0 has real and equal roots.

key_points: For real and equal roots, discriminant D = 0

sub_questions.solution: For the quadratic equation 4x² + kx + 1 = 0, the condition for real and equal roots is that the discriminant D = 0. Here D = k² − 4 × 4 × 1 = k² − 16. Setting D = 0: k² = 16, so k = ±4.

sub_questions.text: यदि 'α' तथा 'β', बहुपद p(y) = y² − 5y + 3 के शून्यक हैं, तो α⁴β³ + α³β⁴ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: If 'α' and 'β' are the zeroes of the polynomial p(y) = y² − 5y + 3, then find the value of α⁴β³ + α³β⁴.
sub_questions.solution: For p(y) = y² − 5y + 3: α + β = 5 and αβ = 3. Now α⁴β³ + α³β⁴ = α³β³(α + β) = (αβ)³ × (α + β) = 3³ × 5 = 27 × 5 = 135.

questions.solution: This question has two alternatives — see sub_questions (a) and (b) above.

questions.text: एक निश्चित परीक्षा प्रश्न के सही उत्तर का अनुमान लगाने की प्रायिकता x/12 है। यदि इसी प्रश्न के सही उत्तर का अनुमान न लगा पाने की प्रायिकता 5/6 है, तो x का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: The probability of guessing the correct answer of a certain test question is x/12. If the probability of not guessing the correct answer is 5/6, then find the value of x.
questions.solution: Since the sum of probabilities of complementary events equals 1: P(correct) + P(not correct) = 1. So x/12 + 5/6 = 1. Therefore x/12 = 1 − 5/6 = 1/6. Multiplying both sides by 12: x = 12 × (1/6) = 2.

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि वृत्त के किसी व्यास के सिरों पर खींची गई स्पर्श-रेखाएँ परस्पर समांतर होती हैं।
questions.text_english: Prove that the tangents drawn at the ends of a diameter of a circle are parallel.

key_points: Tangent at a point is perpendicular to the radius at that point
Both tangents are perpendicular to the same diameter
Two lines perpendicular to the same line are parallel to each other

questions.solution: Let AB be a diameter of a circle with centre O. Let PQ be the tangent at A and RS be the tangent at B. Since the tangent at any point of a circle is perpendicular to the radius through that point: OA ⊥ PQ, so ∠OAP = 90°; and OB ⊥ RS, so ∠OBR = 90°. Since ∠OAP + ∠OBR = 90° + 90° = 180°, these are co-interior angles formed when AB is a transversal cutting PQ and RS. Therefore PQ ∥ RS, i.e., the two tangents are parallel.

sub_questions.text: वह छोटी से छोटी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए जो 644 तथा 462 दोनों से विभाजित हो।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the smallest number which is divisible by both 644 and 462.
sub_questions.solution: To find the smallest number divisible by both 644 and 462, we find their LCM. Prime factorisation: 644 = 2² × 7 × 23 and 462 = 2 × 3 × 7 × 11. LCM = 2² × 3 × 7 × 11 × 23 = 4 × 3 × 7 × 11 × 23 = 21252. The smallest number divisible by both 644 and 462 is 21252.

sub_questions.text: दो संख्याएँ 4 : 5 के अनुपात में हैं तथा उनका म.स. (HCF) 11 है। इन संख्याओं का ल.स. (LCM) ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Two numbers are in the ratio 4 : 5 and their HCF is 11. Find the LCM of these numbers.
sub_questions.solution: Since the two numbers are in the ratio 4 : 5 and their HCF is 11, the numbers are 4 × 11 = 44 and 5 × 11 = 55. Using the relation LCM × HCF = Product of the two numbers: LCM = (44 × 55) / 11 = 2420 / 11 = 220. The LCM of the two numbers is 220.

questions.solution: This question has two alternatives — see sub_questions (a) and (b) above.

questions.text:
52 पत्तों की ताश की गड्डी में से सभी हुकम के तस्वीर वाले पत्ते निकाल दिए गए तथा शेष गड्डी को अच्छी प्रकार से फेंटा गया। शेष गड्डी में से एक पत्ता यादृच्छया निकालने पर निम्नलिखित के प्राप्त होने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए:
(क) एक तस्वीर वाला पत्ता
(ख) एक इक्का अथवा गुलाम वाला पत्ता
questions.text_english:
All face cards of spades are removed from a pack of 52 playing cards and the remaining pack is shuffled well. A card is then drawn at random from the remaining pack. Find the probability of getting:
(a) a face card
(b) an ace or a jack

sub_questions.text: एक तस्वीर वाला पत्ता
sub_questions.text_english: a face card

key_points: Face cards of spades removed: Jack, Queen, King of spades = 3 cards

sub_questions.solution: A standard deck has 12 face cards (3 per suit). Removing face cards of spades (Jack, Queen, King = 3 cards), remaining cards = 52 − 3 = 49, and remaining face cards = 12 − 3 = 9. P(face card) = 9/49.

sub_questions.text: एक इक्का अथवा गुलाम वाला पत्ता
sub_questions.text_english: an ace or a jack

key_points: Total aces in deck = 4 (all present, none removed)
Jacks: Jack of spades removed, so remaining jacks = 3

sub_questions.solution: There are 4 aces in the deck and none were removed, so all 4 aces remain. There are normally 4 jacks, but the Jack of spades was removed, leaving 3 jacks. Total favourable outcomes = 4 + 3 = 7. P(ace or jack) = 7/49 = 1/7.

questions.solution: After removing the 3 face cards of spades (Jack, Queen, King), 49 cards remain. (a) Remaining face cards = 9; P(face card) = 9/49. (b) All 4 aces remain; 3 jacks remain (Jack of spades removed); P(ace or jack) = 7/49 = 1/7.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, केंद्र O वाले वृत्त के बिंदु B पर PB एक स्पर्श-रेखा है। AB वृत्त की एक जीवा है जिसकी लंबाई 24 cm है तथा यह जीवा वृत्त के केंद्र से 5 cm की दूरी पर है। यदि स्पर्श-रेखा PB की लंबाई 20 cm है, तो OP की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: In the given figure, PB is a tangent to the circle with centre O at B. AB is a chord of the circle of length 24 cm and at a distance of 5 cm from the centre of the circle. If the length PB of the tangent is 20 cm, find the length of OP.

key_points: Half chord AM = 12 cm; OM = 5 cm (distance from centre)
OB ⊥ PB (radius to tangent), PB = 20 cm

questions.image_description: A circle with centre O. PB is a tangent at point B. AB is a chord of 24 cm. M is the midpoint of AB, OM ⊥ AB with OM = 5 cm. PB = 20 cm. The figure shows point P outside the circle connected to B by the tangent line.
questions.solution: Let M be the midpoint of chord AB. Then AM = AB/2 = 24/2 = 12 cm, and OM = 5 cm (perpendicular distance from centre to chord). By Pythagoras theorem in △OMA: radius OB = OA = √(AM² + OM²) = √(144 + 25) = √169 = 13 cm. Since PB is a tangent at B, OB ⊥ PB, so in right triangle OBP: OP = √(OB² + PB²) = √(13² + 20²) = √(169 + 400) = √569 cm. Thus OP = √569 cm (approximately 23.85 cm).

questions.text: 10 cm त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त की एक जीवा, वृत्त के केंद्र पर समकोण अंतरित करती है। संगत लघु वृत्तखण्ड का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए। [π = 3.14 प्रयोग कीजिए]
questions.text_english: A chord of a circle of radius 10 cm subtends a right angle at the centre of the circle. Find the area of the corresponding minor segment. [Use π = 3.14]

key_points: Area of triangle = (1/2) × r × r × sin 90° = (1/2) × 10 × 10 × 1 = 50 cm²

questions.solution: Radius r = 10 cm, central angle θ = 90°. Area of sector OAOB = (θ/360°) × πr² = (90/360) × 3.14 × 10² = (1/4) × 314 = 78.5 cm². Area of triangle OAB = (1/2) × r × r × sin 90° = (1/2) × 10 × 10 × 1 = 50 cm². Area of minor segment = Area of sector − Area of triangle = 78.5 − 50 = 28.5 cm².

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि (5√3 + 2/3) एक अपरिमेय संख्या है, जबकि दिया गया है कि √3 एक अपरिमेय संख्या है।
questions.text_english: Prove that (5√3 + 2/3) is an irrational number given that √3 is an irrational number.
questions.solution: Assume, for the sake of contradiction, that (5√3 + 2/3) is rational. Then 5√3 + 2/3 = p/q, where p and q are integers with q ≠ 0. Rearranging: 5√3 = p/q − 2/3 = (3p − 2q)/(3q). Therefore √3 = (3p − 2q)/(15q). Since p and q are integers, (3p − 2q)/(15q) is a rational number, which means √3 would be rational. But this contradicts the given fact that √3 is irrational. Hence our assumption is wrong, and (5√3 + 2/3) is an irrational number.

sub_questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि: √((sec A − 1)/(sec A + 1)) + √((sec A + 1)/(sec A − 1)) = 2 cosec A
sub_questions.text_english: Prove that: √((sec A − 1)/(sec A + 1)) + √((sec A + 1)/(sec A − 1)) = 2 cosec A

key_points: = 2(1/cos A) / (sin A/cos A) = 2/sin A = 2 cosec A = RHS

sub_questions.solution: LHS = √((sec A−1)/(sec A+1)) + √((sec A+1)/(sec A−1)). Combining over a common denominator: LHS = [(sec A−1) + (sec A+1)] / √(sec²A−1) = 2 sec A / √(tan²A) = 2 sec A / tan A = 2(1/cos A) / (sin A/cos A) = 2/sin A = 2 cosec A = RHS. Hence proved.

sub_questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि: (1/cos A − cos A)(1/sin A − sin A) = 1/(tan A + cot A)
sub_questions.text_english: Prove that: (1/cos A − cos A)(1/sin A − sin A) = 1/(tan A + cot A)

key_points: = (sin²A/cos A)(cos²A/sin A) = sin A cos A
RHS = 1/(tan A + cot A) = 1/(sin A/cos A + cos A/sin A) = sin A cos A

sub_questions.solution: LHS = (1/cos A − cos A)(1/sin A − sin A) = ((1 − cos²A)/cos A) × ((1 − sin²A)/sin A) = (sin²A/cos A) × (cos²A/sin A) = sin A · cos A. RHS = 1/(tan A + cot A) = 1/(sin A/cos A + cos A/sin A) = 1/((sin²A + cos²A)/(sin A cos A)) = sin A cos A. Since LHS = RHS = sin A cos A, the identity is proved.

questions.solution: This question has two alternatives — see sub_questions (a) and (b) above.

sub_questions.text: यदि बिंदुओं A(3, 4) तथा B(k, 6) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखण्ड का मध्य-बिंदु P(x, y) है तथा x + y − 10 = 0 है, तो k का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: If the mid-point of the line segment joining the points A(3, 4) and B(k, 6) is P(x, y) and x + y − 10 = 0, find the value of k.
sub_questions.solution: The midpoint P of segment AB where A(3, 4) and B(k, 6) is P = ((3+k)/2, (4+6)/2) = ((3+k)/2, 5). So x = (3+k)/2 and y = 5. Substituting into x + y − 10 = 0: (3+k)/2 + 5 − 10 = 0, giving (3+k)/2 = 5, so 3 + k = 10, hence k = 7.

sub_questions.text: बिंदुओं A(−2, 2) तथा B(2, 8) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखण्ड को चार समान भागों में बाँटने वाले बिंदुओं के निर्देशांक ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the coordinates of the points which divide the line segment joining A(−2, 2) and B(2, 8) into four equal parts.

questions.solution: This question has two alternatives — see sub_questions (a) and (b) above.

questions.text: एक ठोस खिलौना, एक अर्धगोले पर अध्यारोपित एक लंब-वृत्तीय शंकु के आकार का है। शंकु की ऊँचाई 2 cm है तथा इसके आधार का व्यास 4 cm है। इस खिलौने का आयतन ज्ञात कीजिए। खिलौने का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल भी ज्ञात कीजिए। (π = 3.14 लीजिए)
questions.text_english: A solid toy is in the form of a hemisphere surmounted by a right circular cone. The height of the cone is 2 cm and the diameter of the base is 4 cm. Determine the volume of the toy. Also, find the surface area of the toy. (Take π = 3.14)
questions.solution:
Given: radius r = 2 cm (diameter = 4 cm), height of cone h = 2 cm, π = 3.14.

Volume of hemisphere = (2/3)πr³ = (2/3) × 3.14 × 8 = 16.747 cm³ ≈ 16.75 cm³.
Volume of cone = (1/3)πr²h = (1/3) × 3.14 × 4 × 2 = 8.373 cm³ ≈ 8.37 cm³.
Total volume = 16.75 + 8.37 = 25.12 cm³.

Slant height l = √(r² + h²) = √(4 + 4) = 2√2 cm.
Curved surface area of cone = πrl = 3.14 × 2 × 2√2 = 3.14 × 4√2 ≈ 3.14 × 5.657 = 17.76 cm².
Curved surface area of hemisphere = 2πr² = 2 × 3.14 × 4 = 25.12 cm².
Total surface area = 17.76 + 25.12 = 42.88 cm².

questions.text: एक कक्षा के विद्यार्थियों को एकसमान संख्या में पंक्तियों में खड़ा किया गया। यदि प्रत्येक पंक्ति में 3 विद्यार्थी अधिक लिए जाएँ, तो 1 पंक्ति कम हो जाती है। यदि प्रत्येक पंक्ति में 3 विद्यार्थी कम लिए जाएँ, तो 2 पंक्तियाँ अधिक हो जाती हैं। कक्षा में विद्यार्थियों की कुल संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: The students of a class are made to stand equally in rows. If 3 students are extra in each row, there would be 1 row less. If 3 students are less in a row, there would be 2 more rows. Find the number of students in the class.

key_points: Let rows = x, students per row = y; total = xy
Condition 1: (y+3)(x−1) = xy → xy − y + 3x − 3 = xy → 3x − y = 3

questions.solution:
Let the number of rows = x and students per row = y, so total students = xy.

Condition 1 (3 extra per row, 1 less row): (y + 3)(x − 1) = xy. Expanding: xy − y + 3x − 3 = xy, giving 3x − y = 3 ... (i).

Condition 2 (3 less per row, 2 more rows): (y − 3)(x + 2) = xy. Expanding: xy + 2y − 3x − 6 = xy, giving 2y − 3x = 6 ... (ii).

Adding equations (i) and (ii): y = 9. Substituting in (i): 3x − 9 = 3, so x = 4.

Total number of students = x × y = 4 × 9 = 36.
questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables

sub_questions.text: एक समांतर श्रेढ़ी के तीसरे तथा सातवें पदों का योगफल 6 है तथा उनका गुणनफल 8 है। इस समांतर श्रेढ़ी के प्रथम 16 पदों का योगफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: The sum of the third term and the seventh term of an AP is 6 and their product is 8. Find the sum of the first sixteen terms of the AP.
sub_questions.solution:
Let a be the first term and d the common difference. Third term a₃ = a + 2d and seventh term a₇ = a + 6d.

Given: a₃ + a₇ = 6, so 2a + 8d = 6, giving a + 4d = 3 ... (i).
Given: a₃ × a₇ = 8, so (a + 2d)(a + 6d) = 8 ... (ii).

From (i): a = 3 − 4d. Substituting into (ii): (3 − 2d)(3 + 2d) = 8, so 9 − 4d² = 8, giving d² = 1/4, so d = ±1/2.

If d = 1/2: a = 3 − 2 = 1. S₁₆ = (16/2)[2(1) + 15(1/2)] = 8[2 + 7.5] = 8 × 9.5 = 76.
If d = −1/2: a = 3 + 2 = 5. S₁₆ = (16/2)[2(5) + 15(−1/2)] = 8[10 − 7.5] = 8 × 2.5 = 20.

The sum of first 16 terms is 76 or 20.

sub_questions.text: एक पेंटिंग प्रतियोगिता में भाग लेने के लिए बच्चों की न्यूनतम आयु 8 वर्ष है। यह देखा गया कि भाग लेने वालों में से सबसे छोटे बच्चे की आयु 8 वर्ष थी तथा भाग लेने वालों को आयु के अनुसार क्रम में बिठाने पर सार्व अंतर 4 माह का था। यदि सभी भाग लेने वालों की आयु का योगफल 168 वर्ष है, तो पेंटिंग प्रतियोगिता में भाग लेने वाले सबसे बड़े बच्चे की आयु ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: The minimum age of children eligible to participate in a painting competition is 8 years. It is observed that the age of the youngest boy was 8 years and the ages of the participants, when seated in order of age, have a common difference of 4 months. If the sum of the ages of all the participants is 168 years, find the age of the eldest participant in the painting competition.
sub_questions.solution:
First term a = 8 years, common difference d = 4 months = 4/12 = 1/3 year. Sum of ages = 168 years.

Using Sₙ = (n/2)[2a + (n−1)d]: (n/2)[16 + (n−1)/3] = 168. Multiplying by 6: n[48 + (n−1)] = 1008. So n[n + 47] = 1008, giving n² + 47n − 1008 = 0.

Factorising: (n − 21)(n + 48) = 0. Since n > 0, n = 21.

Age of eldest = a + (n−1)d = 8 + 20 × (1/3) = 8 + 20/3 = 44/3 years = 14 years 8 months.

sub_questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, PA, QB तथा RC भुजा AC पर लंबवत हैं। यदि PA = x इकाई, QB = y इकाई तथा RC = z इकाई है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि 1/x + 1/z = 1/y.
sub_questions.text_english: In the given figure, PA, QB and RC are perpendicular to AC. If PA = x units, QB = y units and RC = z units, prove that 1/x + 1/z = 1/y.

key_points: Adding: y/x + y/z = BC/AC + AB/AC = (BC + AB)/AC = AC/AC = 1

sub_questions.solution:
In △PAC and △QBC: ∠QBC = ∠PAC (corresponding angles, QB ∥ PA) and ∠BQC = ∠APC = 90°. By AA similarity: △QBC ~ △PAC. So QB/PA = BC/AC, giving y/x = BC/AC ... (i).

In △QAB and △RAC: ∠QAB = ∠RAC (common angle) and ∠AQB = ∠ARC = 90°. By AA similarity: △QAB ~ △RAC. So QB/RC = AB/AC, giving y/z = AB/AC ... (ii).

Adding (i) and (ii): y/x + y/z = BC/AC + AB/AC = (BC + AB)/AC = AC/AC = 1. Dividing both sides by y: 1/x + 1/z = 1/y. Hence proved.

sub_questions.text: एक त्रिभुज ABC की भुजाएँ AB और BC तथा माध्यिका AD एक अन्य त्रिभुज PQR की क्रमश: भुजाओं PQ और QR तथा माध्यिका PM के समानुपाती हैं। दर्शाइए कि △ABC ~ △PQR है।
sub_questions.text_english: Sides AB and BC and median AD of triangle ABC are respectively proportional to sides PQ and QR and median PM of △PQR. Show that △ABC ~ △PQR.

key_points: D is midpoint of BC, M is midpoint of QR
So BD = BC/2 and QM = QR/2
AB/PQ = BD/QM = AD/PM (since BD = BC/2, QM = QR/2)
With AB/PQ = BC/QR and ∠ABC = ∠PQR: by SAS similarity △ABC ~ △PQR

sub_questions.solution:
Given: AB/PQ = BC/QR = AD/PM, where D and M are midpoints of BC and QR respectively.

Since D is the midpoint of BC: BD = BC/2. Since M is the midpoint of QR: QM = QR/2.

Now AB/PQ = BC/QR = AD/PM implies AB/PQ = BD/QM = AD/PM (dividing BC and QR by 2).

By SSS similarity criterion applied to △ABD and △PQM: △ABD ~ △PQM.

Therefore ∠ABD = ∠PQM, which means ∠ABC = ∠PQR.

Now in △ABC and △PQR: AB/PQ = BC/QR (given) and ∠ABC = ∠PQR (proved above). By SAS similarity criterion: △ABC ~ △PQR. Hence shown.

questions.image_description: Two parts: (a) A triangle with points P, A at left, R, C at right, and Q, B in the middle. PA, QB, RC are perpendicular to AC. The lines from P to C and from R to A cross at Q and B. (b) Two triangles ABC and PQR with medians AD and PM drawn respectively.

questions.text: समुद्र के किनारे एक चट्टान पर एक लाइटहाउस खड़ा है, जो पास से गुजरने वाले जहाजों पर नज़र रखता है। एक दिन लाइटहाउस के शिखर से एक जहाज को किनारे की ओर आते देखने पर पाया कि जैसे ही यह बिंदु P से Q की तरफ आता है, तो इसका अवनमन कोण 30° से 45° में बदल जाता है। लाइटहाउस की ऊँचाई 50 मीटर है।
questions.text_english:
A lighthouse stands tall on a cliff by the sea, watching over ships that pass by. One day a ship is seen approaching the shore and from the top of the lighthouse, the angles of depression of the ship are observed to be 30° and 45° as it moves from point P to point Q. The height of the lighthouse is 50 metres.

Based on the information given above, answer the following questions:

sub_questions.text: जहाज जब बिंदु Q पर है तो इसकी लाइटहाउस के आधार से दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए, जबकि यहाँ का अवनमन कोण 45° है।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the distance of the ship from the base of the lighthouse when it is at point Q, where the angle of depression is 45°.
sub_questions.solution: When the ship is at Q, angle of depression = 45°. Let A be the base of the lighthouse. Then tan 45° = 50/QA, so QA = 50/1 = 50 m. The distance of the ship from the base is 50 metres.

sub_questions.text: ∠PBA तथा ∠QBA की माप ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the measures of ∠PBA and ∠QBA.

key_points: ∠PBA = angle of elevation from P to top of lighthouse = 30°
∠QBA = angle of elevation from Q to top of lighthouse = 45°

sub_questions.solution: B is the top of the lighthouse and A is the base. The angle of depression from B to ship at P is 30°, which equals the angle of elevation from P to B, so ∠PBA = 30°. Similarly, angle of depression from B to ship at Q is 45°, so ∠QBA = 45°.

This sub-question has two alternatives (a) and (b):

(a) Distance P to Q: PA = 50/tan 30° = 50√3 m; QA = 50 m. Distance PQ = PA − QA = 50√3 − 50 = 50(√3 − 1) metres.

(b) Speed from Q to A: QA = 50 m. Time = 10 minutes = 10/60 hours = 1/6 hours. Speed = Distance/Time = 50 m ÷ (1/6 h). Converting: 50 m = 50/1000 km = 0.05 km. Speed = 0.05/(1/6) = 0.05 × 6 = 0.3 km/h.

questions.image_description: A lighthouse of height 50 m on a cliff. B is the top and A is the base. A ship moves from P to Q towards the shore. The angle of depression from B to P is 30° and from B to Q is 45°. The diagram shows horizontal line from B with angle marks 45° and 30°, and P, Q, A on the ground.
questions.solution: Case Study on heights and distances involving a lighthouse of 50 m height with angles of depression 30° and 45° from the top to a ship at points P and Q respectively. See individual sub-question solutions above.

questions.text:
भारत मौसम विज्ञान विभाग प्रत्येक वर्ष देश के विभिन्न उप-विभागों में मौसमी और वार्षिक वर्षा का निरीक्षण करता है। इससे उन्हें परिणामों की तुलना और विश्लेषण करने में सहायता मिलती है।

निम्नलिखित सारणी में उप-विभागों में 2023 में मौसमी वर्षा (mm में) दर्शाई गई है।

वर्षा (mm में) | उप-विभागों की संख्या
200 − 400 | 3
400 − 600 | 4
600 − 800 | 7
800 − 1000 | 4
1000 − 1200 | 3
1200 − 1400 | 3
questions.text_english:
The India Meteorological Department observes seasonal and annual rainfall every year in different sub-divisions of our country. It helps them to compare and analyse the results.

The table below shows sub-divisions wise seasonal (monsoon) rainfall (in mm) in 2023.

Rainfall (mm) | No. of Sub-divisions
200 − 400 | 3
400 − 600 | 4
600 − 800 | 7
800 − 1000 | 4
1000 − 1200 | 3
1200 − 1400 | 3

Based on the information given above, answer the following questions:

sub_questions.text: बहुलक वर्ग लिखिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Write the modal class.

key_points: The class with highest frequency is 600−800 with frequency 7

sub_questions.solution: The modal class is the class interval with the highest frequency. From the table, the class 600 − 800 has the highest frequency of 7. Therefore, the modal class is 600 − 800.

sub_questions.text: यदि वर्षा के मौसम के दौरान कम-से-कम 800 mm वर्षा वाले उप-विभाग को अच्छी वर्षा वाला उप-विभाग माना जाता है, तो कितने उप-विभागों में अच्छी वर्षा हुई?
sub_questions.text_english: If a sub-division having at least 800 mm rainfall during monsoon season is considered a good rainfall sub-division, then how many sub-divisions had good rainfall?
sub_questions.solution: Sub-divisions with at least 800 mm rainfall: 800−1000 has 4, 1000−1200 has 3, and 1200−1400 has 3. Total = 4 + 3 + 3 = 10 sub-divisions had good rainfall.

questions.text: एक उद्यान डिजाइनर एक आयताकार लॉन की योजना बना रहा है, जिसके चारों ओर एकसमान रास्ता बनाया जाना है। लॉन और रास्ते का कुल क्षेत्रफल 360 वर्ग मीटर है। रास्ते की चौड़ाई हर तरफ से समान है। लॉन की विमाएँ 12 मीटर × 10 मीटर हैं।
questions.text_english:
A garden designer is planning a rectangular lawn that is to be surrounded by a uniform walkway. The total area of the lawn and the walkway is 360 square metres. The width of the walkway is same on all sides. The dimensions of the lawn itself are 12 metres by 10 metres.

Based on the information given above, answer the following questions:

sub_questions.text: रास्ते की चौड़ाई को x मीटर लेकर लॉन तथा रास्ते के कुल क्षेत्रफल को निरूपित करने वाला द्विघात समीकरण बनाइए।
sub_questions.text_english: Formulate the quadratic equation representing the total area of the lawn and the walkway, taking width of walkway = x m.
sub_questions.solution: With walkway width x m on each side, the total outer dimensions are (12 + 2x) m by (10 + 2x) m. Total area = (12 + 2x)(10 + 2x) = 360. Expanding: 120 + 24x + 20x + 4x² = 360, giving 4x² + 44x + 120 = 360, so 4x² + 44x − 240 = 0, which simplifies to x² + 11x − 60 = 0.

This sub-question has two alternatives:

(a) Solving x² + 11x − 60 = 0: x = [−11 ± √(121 + 240)]/2 = [−11 ± √361]/2 = [−11 ± 19]/2. Taking positive value: x = (−11 + 19)/2 = 8/2 = 4 m. The width of the walkway is 4 m.

(b) Cost of paving = ₹12,000 at ₹50 per square metre. Area of walkway = 12000/50 = 240 square metres.

sub_questions.text: लॉन का परिमाप ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the perimeter of the lawn.
sub_questions.solution: The lawn has dimensions 12 m × 10 m. Perimeter of the lawn = 2(length + breadth) = 2(12 + 10) = 2 × 22 = 44 metres.
